mainEntity.name: What factors most influence the cost of building a guest house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost of building a guest house depends primarily on whether the structure is attached or detached, its square footage, and its utility requirements. Major cost drivers include site preparation, foundation work, extending water and sewer lines, and upgrading the main electrical panel to handle extra load. Adding a full kitchen and specialized bathroom finishes, such as curbless walk-in showers or custom tile, will also increase the budget. During the consultation and estimating process, defining the exact scope and mechanical layout ensures an accurate, transparent cost estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on square footage, foundation type, kitchen and bath fixtures, and the distance required to tie plumbing and electrical services into the main property.
